headline: Startups worldwide raised $698.3 billion in venture capital in 2026 to the end of September, more than in all of 2025, in fewer but larger deals, according to CB Insights.
score_reason: Kept at 4: new on 12 Oct 2026 and read in full, but it is a quarterly data roundup rather than a single event.
importance_line: Founders outside the biggest AI companies face a thinner market, since deal numbers are the lowest since 2022 and about 80 percent of the money went to rounds of $100 million or more, and AI funding has cooled from a record $239.1 billion in the first quarter to $103.3 billion, but the figures are CB Insights' own count and have not been independently checked.
summary: BeBeez International reports that CB Insights' State of Venture Q3 2026 puts global venture funding at $698.3 billion for 2026 to date, above the $484.1 billion of all 2025, with AI companies taking $495.6 billion, or 71 percent, and OpenAI ($132 billion) and Anthropic ($95 billion) together about a third. The third quarter raised $187.2 billion, down from $219.6 billion in the second, across 6,913 deals, the fewest since 2022, with about 80 percent of the money going to rounds of $100 million or more, while Europe bucked the trend with $31.5 billion, its best quarter since the second quarter of 2022.
notes: Read BeBeez in full; the CB Insights report itself was not found, so every number is CB Insights' as relayed by BeBeez. BeBeez's lead says 698.3 billion 'in 3Q26', but the quarter alone was 187.2 billion; the AI total (495.6 billion = 71 percent) and 'since January' figures fit a total for 2026 to date, so the entry says so. The CB Insights release date is not stated.
